# RDH Magazine

> RDH Magazine is the professional resource for registered dental hygienists covering clinical education, patient care, continuing education, and career development.

RDH Magazine serves dental hygiene professionals with evidence-based clinical content, practice management guidance, and continuing education resources. The site features monthly magazine issues, expert advice columns, clinical case studies, and comprehensive reference hubs on key topics like infection control, periodontitis, and instrument maintenance.

## Key Topics

- Dental Hygiene
- Patient Care
- Periodontal Disease
- Clinical Education
- Continuing Education
- Infection Control
- Instrument Maintenance
- Professional Development
- Occupational Health
- Oral Health
- Board Exam Review
- Periodontitis
- Silver Diamine Fluoride
- Ergonomics
- Career Advancement

## Magazine & Core Resources

- [RDH Magazine Home](https://www.rdhmag.com/home): RDH homepage with professional resources, clinical tips, and continuing education.
- [Registered Dental Hygienist - March 2026](https://digital.rdhmag.com/rdhmag/202603): Monthly RDH Magazine issue for dental hygienists with clinical and professional content.

## Clinical Education & Patient Care

- [Decoding the language of clinical attachment: Clarifying the fundamentals of staging, grading, and CAL](https://www.rdhmag.com/patient-care/article/55320541/decoding-the-language-of-clinical-attachment-clarifying-the-fundamentals-of-staging-grading-and-cal): Educational guide on periodontal assessment using AAP/EFP classification standards.
- [Keeping your instruments' cutting edges: When, why, and how to sharpen](https://www.rdhmag.com/patient-care/article/55288048/keeping-your-instruments-cutting-edges-when-why-and-how-to-sharpen): How-to guide for instrument sharpening and maintenance in dental hygiene practice.
- [Just breathe! Why asthma matters to the dental hygienist part I](https://www.rdhmag.com/patient-care/article/14276058/just-breathe-why-asthma-matters-to-the-dental-hygienist-part-i): Educational guide on asthma pathophysiology and dental hygiene appointment management.
- [Antimicrobial resistance and its effects on the periodontal environment](https://www.rdhmag.com/patient-care/article/55247380/antimicrobial-resistance-and-its-effects-on-the-periodontal-environment): Clinical article on antimicrobial resistance and periodontal treatment efficacy.
- [A glimpse into clinical trends and emerging dental hygiene topics for 2025 and beyond](https://www.rdhmag.com/patient-care/article/55320440/a-glimpse-into-clinical-trends-and-emerging-dental-hygiene-topics-for-2025-and-beyond): Analysis of emerging clinical trends and future directions in dental hygiene practice.
- [Klotho, longevity biology, and oral health](https://www.rdhmag.com/patient-care/article/55358680/klotho-longevity-biology-and-oral-health): Research-driven article on klotho protein and its role in oral health and aging.
- [Case study: Pyogenic granuloma localized on lingual palatal mucosa of nos. 14-15 in a 72-year-old male](https://www.rdhmag.com/patient-care/article/55135876/case-study-pyogenic-granuloma-localized-on-lingual-palatal-mucosa-of-nos-14-15-in-a-72-year-old-male): Case study on oral lesion diagnosis and comprehensive patient evaluation.

## Reference Hubs & Specialized Topics

- [Infection Control](https://www.rdhmag.com/infection-control): Resource center covering sterilization, waterline testing, and disease prevention.
- [Periodontitis](https://www.rdhmag.com/pathology/periodontitis): Reference hub for periodontitis research, therapy, and inflammation management.
- [Silver Diamine Fluoride](https://www.rdhmag.com/patient-care/fluoride/silver-diamine-fluoride): Reference hub for silver diamine fluoride in preventive dentistry and caries control.
- [Ergonomics](https://www.rdhmag.com/ergonomics): Ergonomics resource center for posture, hand strain prevention, and occupational health.

## Career & Professional Development

- [Career & Profession](https://www.rdhmag.com/career-profession): Career development hub covering professional burnout, transitions, and advancement.
- [Continuing Education](https://www.rdhmag.com/career-profession/continuing-education): Continuing education resources and professional development opportunities for hygienists.
- [2026 Dental Hygiene Board review quiz: How's your board exam knowledge?](https://www.rdhmag.com/career-profession/article/55356833/2026-dental-hygiene-board-review-quiz-hows-your-board-exam-knowledge): Board exam review quiz and practice questions for dental hygiene certification.
- [Ask the Pro: Dentist deletes hygienist's clinical notes and denies SRP](https://www.rdhmag.com/career-profession/article/55324740/ask-the-pro-dentist-deletes-hygienists-clinical-notes-and-denies-srp): Expert advice on ethics and legal issues in dental hygiene workplace conflicts.
- [This got you talking: Would you consider getting a doctorate in dental hygiene if it were available?](https://www.rdhmag.com/career-profession/article/55340754/this-got-you-talking-would-you-consider-getting-a-doctorate-in-dental-hygiene-if-it-were-available): Reader discussion on advanced degree opportunities and career advancement in hygiene.

## Pathology & Special Topics

- [Be aware of the tie that binds: A descriptive article of ankyloglossia or tongue-tie](https://www.rdhmag.com/pathology/article/55260021/be-aware-of-the-tie-that-binds-a-descriptive-article-of-ankyloglossia-or-tongue-tie): Clinical overview of ankyloglossia and its impact on infant and maternal health.
